exposure: Nulliparous term singleton vertex (NTSV) cesarean delivery rates <23.9% vs. >=23.9%
cohort: Deliveries at an academic, tertiary care hospital from 2013 to 2019 who had at least two cervical examinations
finding: A machine learning model using intrapartum factors accurately predicted the probability of vaginal delivery early in labor.
mod_finding: The model accurately predicted both vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery.
